Added: A message you queue while Claude is still answering can be edited or cancelled, in Studio and in a PR's chat. While you edit it, it is held back even if Claude is free, and goes out when you save.

whats_new.title: Edit or cancel a queued message
whats_new.text: A message waiting for Claude to finish now has Edit and Cancel. While you edit it, it won't send, even if Claude becomes free; it goes out when you save.
